paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the pre-market with a cautiously negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -36/100. Consolidation Risk is 18/100 (Low).

Nasdaq internals are mixed, so directional confirmation is incomplete (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps mixed, breadth negative).
